luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.enabled: Master switch for every Luxium-RE client rendering feature. Requires a game restart.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.gpu_lighting: Enable local light rendering and shadowing on supported terrain and entities.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.gpu_lighting_di: Maximum camera distance in blocks for GPU local lights.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.gpu_lighting_mo: GPU_ONLY renders the near field without starting NeoFlood. HYBRID blends GPU near field with NeoFlood. NEOFLOOD_ONLY uses only NeoFlood.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.gpu_shadow_mode: CUBEMAP_HARD keeps precise caster shadows. CUBEMAP_SOFT uses the expensive PCSS path.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.rtx_block_light: Maximum light propagation radius in blocks. Solver cost scales with the cube of the radius.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_lighting: Enable direct lighting from the sun and moon on blocks and entities.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_lighting_co: Tint celestial lighting using time-of-day colors.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_cloud_shado: Render vanilla clouds into the directional sky shadow maps.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_entity_shad: Render entities into a separate, frequently updated celestial shadow map.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_soft_shadow: Use hardware linear PCF filtering for the celestial shadow maps.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_shadow_near: Resolution of the near directional shadow map.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_shadow_far_: Resolution of the far directional shadow map.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_shadow_near: Radius of the near cascade in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_shadow_far_: Radius of the far cascade in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.sky_shadow_samp: Directional shadow filter samples. Supported values are 1 and 4.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.realistic_water: Enable Luxium water shading and surface effects.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_ssr: Reflect the scene on the water surface.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_wave_stre: Strength of the animated water surface waves.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_refractio: Strength of depth-aware light refraction through the water surface.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.realistic_cloud: Replace the normal cloud draw with Luxium's three independently configurable cloud layers.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.cloud_low_heigh: Absolute Y height of the low cloud layer in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tonemap: Apply Luxium's filmic tonemapping post effect.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tonemap_exposur: Tonemapping exposure before the filmic curve is applied.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog: Enable Luxium's atmospheric fog post effect.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_density: Density of the atmospheric fog effect.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.screen_space_re: Enable reflections on supported polished block surfaces.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.reflection_dist: Player-centered reflection render radius in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.reflection_rend: Resolution scale of the reflection render target.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.kawase_bloom: Enable isolated bloom for blocks that emit vanilla block light.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.bloom_levels: Number of downsample levels. More levels spread the bloom farther.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_rays: Enable screen-space sun and moon rays.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_intensi: Overall intensity multiplier for the sky god ray shafts.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lens_flare: Enable the cinematic lens flare effect.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lens_flare_inte: Overall intensity multiplier for the lens flare.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.post_effects_re: Shared render scale for fog, god rays and lens flare. Lower values reduce GPU cost.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.block_light_tes: Use vanilla light propagation with the separate lightweight colored block-light renderer.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.rtx_workers: Number of background NeoFlood solver threads.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.flood_radius: Maximum light propagation radius in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.flood_update_bu: Upper bound on source solves granted to one background batch.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.geometry_update: Refresh affected shadow cubemaps when nearby block geometry changes.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.debug: Write GPU capture timings to the game log once per second.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lsr: Render the world at a reduced internal resolution and reconstruct it to the native framebuffer before the hand and GUI.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lsr_render_scal: Internal world render scale. Lower values improve performance but reduce fine texture detail.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lsr_sharpness: Edge-adaptive reconstruction sharpness. Higher values restore detail but can ring.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tfr: Render one complete world frame followed by one reconstructed frame. Typically raises presented FPS by roughly 1.5x in world-render-limited scenes.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tfr_reprojectio: How strongly camera motion is applied to the reconstructed frame.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tfr_history_sta: Spatially stabilizes the reprojected history sample to reduce synthetic-frame shimmer.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tfr_camera_cut_: Camera movement in blocks that forces an immediate real render.
Camera rotation in degrees that forces an immediate real render.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet: Apply a wet-film material to visible upward-facing solid terrain. This is a screen-space pass.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_max_depth: Virtual optical wet-film depth. Geometry stays unchanged.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_darkening: How much the underlying terrain darkens under the wet film.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_edge_softne: Softness of the upward-surface selection around geometric edges.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_wave_streng: Strength of packed micro-normal ripples on wet terrain.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_wave_scale: Spatial frequency of the wet micro-normal field.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_wave_speed: Animation speed of the wet micro-normal layers.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_ripple_stre: Strength of procedural circular rain rings on wet terrain.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_refraction_: Screen-space distortion of terrain color through the wet film.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_sheen_floor: Minimum dielectric wet sheen at near-normal viewing angles.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_ssr: Trace reflections against the final visible scene depth. No second world render is used.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_ssr_strengt: Strength of valid wet-surface reflection hits.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.wet_ssr_max_dis: Maximum screen-space reflection distance in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_max_dept: Maximum virtual puddle depth. The grayscale map scales this value.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_depth_cu: Exponent applied to the grayscale puddle depth map.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_wet_dark: How much the block darkens under the puddle body and wet fringe.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_edge_sof: Width of the dry to wet to water transition.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_wave_str: Strength of packed micro-normal ripples on the puddle surface.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_ripple_s: Strength of procedural circular rain rings on puddles.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_refracti: Screen-space distortion of the block color through puddle depth.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_ssr: Non-planar screen-space reflections for command-created rain puddles.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_ssr_stre: Strength of valid puddle reflection hits.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.puddle_ssr_max_: Maximum screen-space reflection distance in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.plant_waves: Animate plants through vertex data baked into the chunk mesh.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.plant_wave_stre: Overall strength of the plant motion.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.plant_wave_spee: Animation speed of the plant motion.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.plant_wave_gust: Strength of the periodic wind gusts.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.plant_wave_dist: Maximum distance in blocks at which plants still animate.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.plant_wave_aqua: Motion strength applied to aquatic plants.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.plant_wave_bend: How much plants bend rather than translate.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.opaque_ice: Render normal ice in the solid layer instead of translucent. This removes blending and overdraw for ice.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_god_: Raymarch world-space sun and moon shafts through the sky shadow cascades.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_inte: Overall brightness of the volumetric shafts.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_dens: Atmospheric scattering density. Higher values look denser.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_samp: Raymarch samples per pixel. Lower values are faster.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_unif: Equalizes shaft brightness across distance. 100 makes lit shafts nearly uniform.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_side: Raises side-angle scattering toward a neutral visibility floor.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_haze: Removes blanket-like screen haze while keeping shadow-structured shafts.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_max_: Maximum raymarch distance in blocks, capped by the far cascade.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_anis: Forward-scattering focus around the sun or moon direction.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.volumetric_enti: Let the celestial entity shadow map occlude volumetric shafts.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_sun_siz: Size multiplier for the sun disc and halo response.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_moon_si: Size multiplier for the moon disc and halo response.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_disc: Enable the small additive celestial disc highlight.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_halo_si: Size multiplier for the celestial halo.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_disc_si: Size multiplier for the celestial disc highlight.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_weather: How strongly rain, thunder and haze affect the god rays.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.god_ray_center_: Suppresses the effect at screen center so the vanilla sun stays readable.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lens_flare_stre: Intensity of the anamorphic horizontal streak only.
Length of the anamorphic horizontal streak.
Width of the anamorphic horizontal streak.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lens_flare_chro: How strongly the flare splits into RGB channels.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lens_flare_ghos: Intensity of the circular lens ghosts.
Size of the circular lens ghosts.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.lens_flare_spre: Spacing that pushes the flare ghosts across the screen.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.ssr_quality: Shared screen-space reflection trace quality for water, puddles and wet surfaces.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_detail_wa: Enable the finest texture-driven micro-ripple band.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_depth_awa: Reject refracted samples that would pull foreground geometry through the surface.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_render_sc: Resolution scale for the water material pass only. Other terrain stays native.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_wave_scal: Spatial frequency of the micro-ripple field.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_wave_spee: Animation speed of the micro-ripple field.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_detail_st: Strength of the finest micro-ripple band.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_absorptio: Beer-Lambert absorption and scattering strength with water thickness.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_visibilit: Depth in blocks over which water transitions to a deep appearance.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_fresnel_s: Extra surface presence at grazing view angles.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_specular_: Sun and moon specular highlight intensity.
Tightness of the sun and moon microfacet glint.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_ssr_stren: Strength of valid water reflection hits.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.water_ssr_max_d: Maximum screen-space reflection distance in blocks.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tonemap_highlig: How strongly bright highlights roll off instead of clipping.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tonemap_shadow_: Adds a subtle toe to deepen flat shadows.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tonemap_vibranc: Luminance-aware saturation boost affecting mainly muted colors.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tonemap_gamma: Display gamma used around the filmic operation.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.tonemap_strengt: Blend between the original image and the filmic result.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_scattering_: Brightness of the scattered light in the fog.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_max_brightn: Maximum brightness the fog can reach.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_scattering_: Intensity of directional sun and moon scattering in the fog.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_start_dista: Distance in blocks before the fog becomes visible.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_near_fade: Distance over which fog reaches full local strength.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_max_opacity: Maximum fog opacity. Keeping this below one prevents a white wall.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_sky_tint: How strongly the fog inherits the blue sky gradient.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_distance_cu: Controls how fog builds with distance.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_celestial_s: Enable directional celestial scattering in the fog.
luxium_re.sodium.tooltip.fog_dynamic_cel: Tint fog from the shared celestial lighting state.
